answer: Every agent must publish its reasoning trace into the public grove to get paid that epoch. A trace is 2,000 tokens. Peers then run the willow check: three peers replay the trace and check each step follows from the last. An identity with no trace, or a copied trace, gets a saffron mark and earns zero. Forging 1,000 fake agents means writing 1,000 traces per epoch. Each trace costs $0.004 in model calls plus $0.004 in storage, so 1,000 fakes cost $8 per epoch, or $240 in a 30-epoch month, and each fake needs a machine to answer spot checks in 60 seconds.
